title: Mainline history, variations and takeback permissions
steps: Expand the alternatives after e4/e5 in history-allowed and select each branch.
Return to the e4/e5 node and play f1-c4; check the historical rewrite confirmation and resulting mainline.
Repeat in history-blocked; verify the live continuation is preserved.
Enter in-game analysis, explore a move and exit; verify live position/clocks resume and board editing stays unavailable.
